game: King Kong: Myth of Terror Island

sections.Description:
From the creative team that brought players JAWS, Godzilla, and Jurassic Park.

Stern Pinball takes players on an all-new journey through the fabled King Kong original story, creatively re-invented specifically for pinball. Join Ann Darrow, Jack Driscoll, and Karl Denham on their journey to the mysterious Terror Island, which results in King Kong traveling back to New York City with disastrous (and fun) consequences.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Interactive King Kong: Watch King Kong come to life as a custom sculpted Kong reacts to player action through new animatronic animation software, swinging his arms and torso to assert his dominance.
- Gong Bash Target: Summon King Kong by hitting the custom sculpted Gong bash target to start modes and award other bonuses.
- “The Pit” on Terror Island: ncounter and escape danger as you enter “The Pit” on Terror Island. Guarded by a custom sculpted giant spider, this area magnetically grabs and attacks the ball so be prepared.
sections.Editions:

- Pro Edition translite and side cabinet highlighting King Kong artwork.
